summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType; rich/control.py adds the title format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool gated on is_terminal, mirroring show_cursor; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title with the control's second item; CHANGELOG.md gains an Unreleased "Added" bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (console, skipped on Windows), test_control_title (control), and test_control_set_window_title (Windows renderer, mocked wrapper). Nothing was run, per instructions, so Black formatting and test results are unverified. No commits were made.
